latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of UGC Factory: an AI-powered content generation API for video, scripts, automation, and analysis.

- Launches complete API for autonomous UGC creation: script writing, video production with avatars and synthetic voices, and scheduling.
- Offers tools for TikTok and YouTube analysis, content automation, and prompt suggestions.
- Provides media management features including B-roll sourcing, uploads, audits, and watermark removal.
- Requires x402 (USDC on Base) payment for all endpoints.
